groups.label: Cardinal & Ordinal Numerals
rules: Cardinals: one, two, three, ten, twenty, hundred, thousand, million.
Ordinals: first (1st), second (2nd), third (3rd), fourth (4th), twenty-first (21st).
Stress rule: -teen numbers stress 2nd syllable (thir-TEEN); -ty numbers stress 1st syllable (THIR-ty).
